name_en: Prestimulus alpha phase predicting temporal perception
name_zh: 刺激前 α 相位对时间知觉的预测
reason: Whether two stimuli are seen as simultaneous or ordered depends on the phase of the ongoing occipital alpha rhythm at stimulus onset (Varela et al. 1981, doi:10.1016/0028-3932(81)90005-1). MK.alpha_posterior (alpha power) is used as the closest marker; it indexes power, not phase. Further evidence not yet searched (curator_a, sprint 6, 2026-10-16).

name_en: Location-specific auditory cortical response (sound location processing)
name_zh: 声源位置特异的听觉皮层响应
reason: No registry marker indexes sound location processing. PER-AUDLOC-001 uses MK.N1_auditory (EEG) and MK.BOLD_auditory_cortex (fMRI; Zatorre et al. 2002, doi:10.1038/nn904) as closest markers. Maintainer to decide whether a separate marker is warranted; EEG evidence not yet searched (curator_a, sprint 6, 2026-10-16).

name_zh: 顶区 P2p 数值距离效应
reason: Dehaene 1996 (doi:10.1162/jocn.1996.8.1.47) reports the numerical distance effect over parietal electrodes in the ERP during number comparison. No registry marker covers it; CTL-NUM-001 uses MK.BOLD_frontoparietal as the closest marker (curator_c, sprint 6, 2026-10-16).
